root_cause: The footer links were promoted to production in PR #3579 while the three linked root pages were not part of that candidate, leaving production navigation ahead of its destination content.
prevention_rule: A public navigation change is complete only when every new internal destination exists in the same current-main lineage, has canonical metadata, is covered by static i18n, and is classified in the website delivery lane before promotion.

evidence.outcome: PR #3581 adds /gebruiksvoorwaarden, /cookiebeleid and /systeemstatus as canonical root pages, completes their English translation cache and classifies all three as website delivery paths.
